title: AsteroidKVM audio_detected event, version 1
description: The JSON body sent by AsteroidKVM for audio detections and manual test notifications. All documented fields are required; additional properties are allowed for compatible extensions. Validate the decoded JPEG separately.

version.description: Payload version, independent of the AsteroidKVM app version.

timestamp.description: Sender wall-clock time when the attempt was admitted, before screenshot encoding. Currently emitted in UTC with whole seconds; this is not a unique event identifier.

message.description: Plain display text: Audio detected on (or Test notification from for manual tests) followed by a space and the nonempty alias, otherwise the connection name.

id.description: Saved connection profile UUID, not an appliance serial number or event ID. Scope it to the authenticated integration. UUID letter case is not significant.

name.description: User-assigned connection name; mutable and not necessarily unique.

alias.description: Notification alias with surrounding whitespace trimmed. Always present, and empty when unset.

audioLevel.description: Highest normalized decoded-buffer RMS level since the previous approximately one-second poll, before local playback gain. Actual triggered events have a positive level; manual tests use 0. Not a sound pressure measurement.

base64.description: Standard padded base64 of valid JPEG bytes, with no data URL prefix or line breaks. Decode and verify the JPEG separately; schema annotations do not validate image contents.

width.description: Actual encoded JPEG width in pixels. Must match decoded image dimensions. The current encoder downsizes toward a 1600-pixel longest side with integer image bounds.

height.description: Actual encoded JPEG height in pixels. Must match decoded image dimensions. Enforce an independent receiver pixel limit before full image decoding.
